name: Devil in the Details
source:
A visual novel game following a young man after he is mugged and makes a deal with a succubus demon to stay alive. Now he must do her bidding, finding and exorcising demons on the mortal realm in a multi-ending story game where your choices affect the outcome.

[From [url=https://dharker.studio/#/devil-in-the-details/]Official Website[/url]]
translation:
一款讲述年轻男子遭抢劫后与魅魔恶魔签订契约以求生存的视觉小说。如今，他必须听从她的命令，在人间寻找并驱逐恶魔；在这款多结局游戏中，你的选择将影响结局。

[来源：[url=https://dharker.studio/#/devil-in-the-details/]官方网站[/url]]
